newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz Life sees strong new business in 97.
newsitem.headline: Allianz Life sees strong new business in 97.

text.p: Allianz Lebensversicherungs AG, the life insurance arm of Allianz AG, said on Wednesday it expected new business in 1997 to outpace the first quarter, when it rose nearly seven percent.
The company said its first quarter new premium income rose 6.7 percent to 783 million marks.
Chairman Gerhard Rupprecht told a news conference that the increase for the full year should be "significantly higher'.
Allianz Life's premium income rose 4.3 percent to 12 billion marks in 1996 while net profit advanced some 20 percent to 190 million marks.
In February, the bank said its new business rose 9.8 percent to 2.5 billion marks last year.
Elaborating on those results on Wednesday, the insurer said its sums insured advanced to 290.2 billion marks from 276.4 billion marks.
The company plans to pay an unchanged dividend of 11 marks per share, plus a bonus dividend of 1.50 marks to mark its 75th anniversary.
